rules: Verify stock, price, footprint, and panel dimensions before ordering or cutting.
Use only certified external low-voltage supplies; no mains voltage enters QEC-1.
Substitutions must meet or exceed voltage, current, temperature, and connector ratings.

items.substitutionRule: Any genuine Raspberry Pi 5 with at least 4 GB; revise thermal and storage acceptance records if changed.
Pi 5-compatible active cooling that passes the closed-enclosure thermal test.

items.description: Official 27 W USB-C power supply, US
items.substitutionRule: Certified USB-C supply explicitly supporting the Pi 5 5 V / 5 A profile.

items.description: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 with headers added by builder
items.substitutionRule: Pico 2 W is acceptable if the same wired USB CDC and assigned GPIO map are retained.

items.description: Certified external 5 V / 5 A desktop supply
items.substitutionRule: Certified regulated external 5 V supply rated at least 5 A; connector and polarity must match the selected fused entry harness.

items.description: Addressable RGB LED, 5 mm diffused, five-pack
items.substitutionRule: Sixty compatible 5 V addressable through-hole pixels; confirm pin order and current before wiring. Four units are spares.

items.description: Quad buffer with TTL-compatible input thresholds, DIP-14
items.substitutionRule: 74AHCT125 or proven 3.3 V-to-5 V unidirectional pixel-data shifter; do not use a passive divider.
1000 uF low-ESR electrolytic rated at least 10 V and 105 C; observe polarity.
MX-compatible normally-open switch matching the 14 mm subplate cutouts; buy one sample and verify latch fit first.
Genuine 1N4148-compatible diode; keep orientation identical across the matrix.

covers: fused panel entry harness and switch
enclosure hardware, feet, labels, and ventilation
